title: Fix rejected drain PR #93 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-4)
description:
Drain PR #93 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-4`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-4 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-4`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-4` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- package-lock.json and node_modules/.sdlc-drain-deps files incorrectly included in diff
- runWeeklySteps function signature mismatch - runner expects (label, script, args) but runStep from monthly-review.mjs has different signature
- test 'uses the default runStep from monthly-review when no runner provided' is incomplete - doesn't actually test default runner functionality
